title: Castle Master
build: Original Domark disk (castle_master[domark_1990](!).g64, C64 Preservation Project); language menu reached from a hard reset

tools.host: Linux 6.18 x86_64, Ubuntu 24.04 cloud container with four cores (Intel Xeon) and no display
tools.emulator: VICE, release v3.13.2, v3.13.2-linux-x86_64-gui.zip (vice-mcp), run under Xvfb and driven through kit/c64/vice.py; check-emulator 54 of 54
tools.browser: Chromium 141.0.7390.37 (Playwright 1.56.1's), for the page checks and screenshots
tools.simulator: kit/c64/cpu6502.js, for test_world.js, test_music.js and test_meter.js
tools.subagents: six checker agents on the Agent tool's opus alias for 60-verify: one for each sample, one for each of the audit's four ranges and one for facts.md, one at a time; all other work by one agent
